local Theme = require("abyss_theme")
local RoomMotion = require('abyss_node_ui_motion')
local RewardDetail = require('abyss_node_ui_reward_detail')
local C = Theme.color
local layout = Theme.layout.nativeNode
local M = {}

local function currentNodeFlow(ui)
    if ui.run then return ui.run.nodeFlow end
end

local function neowChoiceChrome(ctx, box, look, hover, pressed)
    local chrome = box:GetChild('stsNeowChrome')
    if not chrome then return end
    -- Hiding/resetting the page also runs after navigation retires its Run.
    local flow = currentNodeFlow(ctx.self)
    local active = flow and flow.event and flow.event.id == 'neow'
    chrome:SetVisible(active == true)
    for _,name in ipairs({'v25BaseMaterial','v25StateChrome','v25Corner0_0','v25Corner0_1','v25Corner1_0','v25Corner1_1'})do
        local part=box:GetChild(name);if part then part:SetVisible(not active)end
    end
    if not active then return end
    for _, name in ipairs({'border','normal','hover','pressed','disabled','selected'}) do box:GetChild(name):SetVisible(false) end
    local token = layout.event.neow.stsChoice
    local face = not look.enabled and token.disabled or pressed and token.pressed or hover and token.hover or token.face
    for _, part in ipairs(chrome:GetChild('face'):GetChildren()) do ctx.tint(part, face) end
end

local function referenceCamp(ctx, box)
    local reference, camp = layout.camp.reference, ctx.child('campView')
    if not reference or box.parent ~= camp then return end
    local rest, forge = camp:GetChild('rest'), camp:GetChild('forge')
    local focus = ctx.buttonHover == forge or ctx.buttonPress and ctx.buttonPress.box == forge
    rest:GetChild('description'):SetVisible(not focus);forge:GetChild('description'):SetVisible(focus == true)
    ctx.tint(box:GetChild('border'), box == rest and reference.restEdge or reference.forgeEdge)
    ctx.tint(box:GetChild('hover'), box == rest and reference.restHover or reference.forgeHover)
end

local function referenceShop(ctx, box, look, hover)
    if layout.shop.referenceBareGoods and box:GetChild('v25BareGoods') then
        for _, state in ipairs({'normal','hover','pressed','disabled','selected'}) do box:GetChild(state):SetVisible(false) end
        box:GetChild('v25GoodsFocus'):SetVisible(hover or look.selected == true)
    end
    if layout.shop.referenceRemovalBorder and box == ctx.child('shopView'):GetChild('removal') then
        ctx.tint(box:GetChild('border'), layout.shop.referenceRemovalBorder)
    end
end

local function referenceChrome(ctx, box, look, hover)
    local reference = layout.event.reference
    if reference and box.parent == ctx.child('eventView') then
        ctx.tint(box:GetChild('hover'), reference.hover)
        ctx.tint(box:GetChild('pressed'), reference.pressed)
        ctx.tint(box:GetChild('border'), hover and reference.hoverBorder or reference.border)
    end
    local buttons = layout.referenceButtons
    if not buttons then return end
    local label = box:GetChild('label')
    if label then
        local palette = box.parent == ctx.root and buttons.flag or buttons.choice
        ctx.tint(box:GetChild('hover'), palette.hover);ctx.tint(box:GetChild('pressed'), palette.pressed)
        ctx.ink(label, look.enabled and buttons.ink or buttons.disabledInk)
    end
    referenceCamp(ctx, box)
    referenceShop(ctx, box, look, hover)
end

-- Installs the feedback responsibility on one node UI instance.
function M.install(ctx)
    ctx.buttonLooks, ctx.buttonHover, ctx.buttonPress = {}, nil, nil

    function ctx.paintButton(box)
        local look = ctx.buttonLooks[box]
        if not look then return end -- a never-shown view can still receive a late native exit
        local enabled = look.enabled and not look.selected
        local pressed = enabled and ctx.buttonPress and ctx.buttonPress.box == box
        local hover = enabled and ctx.buttonHover == box and not pressed
        local function showButtonState()
            box:GetChild("normal"):SetVisible(look.enabled and not look.selected and not pressed and not hover)
            box:GetChild("hover"):SetVisible(hover == true)
            box:GetChild("pressed"):SetVisible(pressed == true)
            box:GetChild("disabled"):SetVisible(not look.enabled)
            box:GetChild("selected"):SetVisible(look.selected == true)
        end
        showButtonState()
        local function paintButtonFrame()
            ctx.tint(box:GetChild("hover"), look.primary and C.goldBright or C.buttonHover)
            ctx.tint(box:GetChild("pressed"), C.buttonPressedFill)
            ctx.tint(box:GetChild("border"), look.selected and C.goldBright or not look.enabled and C.line
                or (pressed or hover or look.primary) and C.goldBright or C.gold)
            local function paintButtonLabel()
                local label = box:GetChild("label")
                if label then ctx.ink(label, not look.enabled and C.textMuted or pressed and C.buttonPressedText
                        or look.selected and C.goldBright or look.primary and C.textOnLight or C.goldBright) end
                -- The official material is dark in every state. Its shared ink
                -- must survive render/hover/press instead of inheriting the old
                -- light-primary-button contract from the unskinned node page.
                if label and Theme.presentationProfile=='official-assets-first' then
                    ctx.ink(label,look.enabled and Theme.officialAssets.buttonInk or C.textMuted)
                end
            end
            paintButtonLabel()

        end
        paintButtonFrame()
        referenceChrome(ctx, box, look, hover)
        neowChoiceChrome(ctx, box, look, hover, pressed)
        local scale = pressed and layout.buttonStates.pressedScale or layout.buttonStates.normalScale
        box:SetLocalScale(scale, scale, 1)
    end

    ctx.buttonInputs, ctx.actionInputs = {}, {}

    function ctx.retireAction(entry)
        if not entry or not entry.observe then return end
        if entry.retire then entry.retire() end
        for _, input in pairs(ctx.buttonInputs) do
            for _, gesture in pairs(input.active) do if gesture.action == entry then gesture.action = nil end end
            if input.released and input.released.action == entry then input.released.action = nil end
        end
    end

    function ctx.observeAction(entry)
        if not entry.observe or entry.observe() then return true end
        ctx.retireAction(entry)
        return false
    end

    ctx.inspectCards={}


    ctx.roomMotion = RoomMotion.new(ctx.self,ctx.child,ctx.options)

    ctx.rewardDetail=RewardDetail.new(ctx.self,ctx.child('treasureView'):GetChild('details'),ctx.options)

    ctx.swipe, ctx.swallow = nil, nil

    function ctx.resetButtons()
        ctx.rewardDetail:reset()
        ctx.buttonHover, ctx.buttonPress, ctx.swipe = nil, nil, nil
        ctx.self.inspectPress=nil
        for _, input in pairs(ctx.buttonInputs) do input.active, input.released = {}, nil end
        for box in pairs(ctx.buttonLooks) do ctx.paintButton(box) end
    end

    function ctx.state(box, enabled, selected, primary)
        ctx.buttonLooks[box] = {enabled=enabled == true, selected=selected == true, primary=primary == true}
        ctx.paintButton(box)
    end
end
return M

local F=dofile('tests/lua/support/game_ui_fixture.lua')
local Asset=require('abyss_traveler_portrait_assets')
assert(#Asset.avatar96.rows==457 and #Asset.selection133.rows==1940 and #Asset.battle133.rows==4315)
Asset.imagePrefabId,Asset.containerPrefabId=41,73
local lowpolyHero=assert(Asset.lowpolyHero)
assert(#lowpolyHero.rows==2011)
local function profile(useLowpoly,expected)
Asset.lowpolyHero=useLowpoly and lowpolyHero or nil
local root=F.Viewport.apply(F.control({children=F.Layout}),1280,720)
local selection=root:GetChild('characterPanel'):GetChild('details'):GetChild('officialSelectionFigure')
local created,destroyed=0,0
local images={}
local methods={}
function methods:SetVisible(value)self.visible=value end
function methods:SetActive(value)self.active=value end
function methods:SetImage(source,id)
 assert(source=='static');self.imageId=id;images[#images+1]=self
end
function methods:SetLocalRotation(x,y,z)self.rotation={x,y,z}end
function methods:SetAsLastSibling()self.ordered=true end
for _,name in ipairs({'SetAnchorMin','SetAnchorMax','SetPivot','SetSizeDelta','SetLocalScale','SetAnchoredPosition'})do
 methods[name]=function()end
end
for _,host in ipairs({selection,root:GetChild('characterPanel'):GetChild('traveler'):GetChild('officialAvatar'),root:GetChild('battlePanel'):GetChild('hero'):GetChild('officialFigure')})do
 for name,method in pairs(methods)do host[name]=method end
end
Enum={ImageSource={StaticReference='static'},ImageType={Stretch=23}}
Color={FromRGBA=function(...)return {...}end}
game={InstantiateClientUIControl=function(index,parent)
 assert(index==41 or index==73,'selection must use bound image/container templates')
 created=created+1
 local c=setmetatable({parent=parent,alive=true},{__index=methods})
 if created==1 then assert(parent==selection,'thumbnail delayed the main figure')end
 return c
end,DestroyClientUIControl=function()destroyed=destroyed+1 end}
local portraits=require('abyss_traveler_portraits').new(root,nil,{selectionAvatar=true,battlePortrait=true})
portraits:sync('menu',true,false,'ironclad')
for _=1,500 do
 local before=created;portraits:tick()
 assert(created-before<=64,'selection exceeded shared per-tick creation budget')
 if portraits:status().avatar.phase=='ready'then break end
end
local status=portraits:status()
assert(status.selection.phase=='ready' and status.avatar.phase=='ready',status.selection.phase..':'..tostring(status.selection.reason)..' / '..status.avatar.phase..':'..tostring(status.avatar.reason))
assert(status.batchSize==64 and status.battle.phase=='idle','selection must retain batch budget and leave battle art unloaded')
assert(created==expected,'unexpected selection native control count: '..created)
if useLowpoly then
 assert(#images==2011,'current selection did not render every low-poly image')
 for i,c in ipairs(images)do
  local row=lowpolyHero.rows[i]
  assert(c.imageId==row[1] and c.rotation[1]==row[19] and c.rotation[2]==row[20]
   and c.rotation[3]==row[14] and c.ordered,'low-poly image/rotation/order drift at row '..i)
 end
else assert(#images==0,'legacy selection must use its rectangle-only profile')end
portraits:sync('map',false,false,'ironclad')
portraits:sync('menu',true,false,'ironclad');portraits:tick()
assert(created==expected and destroyed==0,'return to selection rebuilt cached images')
portraits:onEngineDestroy();assert(destroyed==0)
end
profile(true,2512)
-- Retain the exact legacy selection133 contract, independently of the default low-poly branch.
profile(false,2440)
Asset.lowpolyHero=lowpolyHero
print('SELECTION_BUDGET_LOADING_PASS')

local F=dofile('tests/lua/support/game_ui_fixture.lua')
local Asset=require('abyss_traveler_portrait_assets')
Asset.imagePrefabId,Asset.containerPrefabId=41,73
local lowpolyHero=assert(Asset.lowpolyHero)
assert(#lowpolyHero.rows==2011 and #Asset.avatar96.rows==457 and #Asset.selection133.rows==1940 and #Asset.battle133.rows==4315)
local function profile(useLowpoly,battleEnabled,expected)
Asset.lowpolyHero=useLowpoly and lowpolyHero or nil
local root=F.Viewport.apply(F.control({children=F.Layout}),1280,720)
local panel=root:GetChild('characterPanel')
panel:SetVisible(false)
local selection=panel:GetChild('details'):GetChild('officialSelectionFigure')
local avatar=panel:GetChild('traveler'):GetChild('officialAvatar')
local battle=root:GetChild('battlePanel'):GetChild('hero'):GetChild('officialFigure')
local battleFallback=root:GetChild('battlePanel'):GetChild('hero'):GetChild('portrait')
local created,destroyed=0,0
local counts={selection=0,avatar=0,battle=0}
local foreground=false
local methods={}
function methods:SetVisible(value)self.visible=value end
function methods:SetActive(value)self.active=value end
function methods:SetImage(source,id)assert(source=='static' and type(id)=='number');self.imageId=id end
for _,name in ipairs({'SetAnchorMin','SetAnchorMax','SetPivot','SetSizeDelta','SetLocalScale','SetLocalRotation','SetAnchoredPosition','SetAsLastSibling'})do
 methods[name]=function()end
end
for _,host in ipairs({selection,avatar,battle})do for name,method in pairs(methods)do host[name]=method end end
Enum={ImageSource={StaticReference='static'},ImageType={Stretch=23}}
Color={FromRGBA=function(...)return {...}end}
game={InstantiateClientUIControl=function(index,parent)
 assert(index==41 or index==73,'portrait must use bound native templates')
 created=created+1
 if created==1 then assert(parent==selection,'thumbnail preloaded before the main figure')end
 local owner,name=parent,nil
 while owner do
  if owner==selection then name='selection';break elseif owner==avatar then name='avatar';break elseif owner==battle then name='battle';break end
  owner=owner.parent
 end
 assert(name,'native control escaped its dedicated portrait host')
 assert(name~='battle' or foreground,'battle art was preloaded')
 counts[name]=counts[name]+1
 return setmetatable({parent=parent,alive=true},{__index=methods})
end,DestroyClientUIControl=function()destroyed=destroyed+1 end}
local portraits=require('abyss_traveler_portraits').new(root,nil,{selectionAvatar=true,battlePortrait=battleEnabled})
local function tick()
 local before=created;portraits:tick()
 assert(created-before<=64 and portraits:status().batchSize==64,'shared portrait creation budget exceeded')
end
local function queue()
 local s=portraits:status();local rows={}
 for _,name in ipairs({'selection','avatar','battle'})do local v=s[name]
  assert(v.phase~='failed' and v.phase~='release_failed',name..': '..tostring(v.reason))
  rows[#rows+1]=name..':'..v.phase..':'..tostring(v.nextIndex)..':'..v.owned
 end
 return table.concat(rows,'|')
end
local function record(label)
 print('PRELOAD_PROFILE',useLowpoly and 'lowpoly' or 'legacy',battleEnabled,label,
  'selection',counts.selection,'avatar',counts.avatar,'battle',counts.battle,'destroyed',destroyed,queue())
end
portraits:sync('menu',false,false,'ironclad')
tick();assert(created==0,'legacy sync unexpectedly enabled preloading')
portraits:sync('menu',false,false,'ironclad',true)
assert(created==0,'preload sync created geometry synchronously')
tick();assert(created>0 and created<=64 and not panel.visible,'preload was unbounded or revealed selection')
assert(counts.battle==0 and destroyed==0,'background preload must not build battle art or enter failure cleanup')
record('partial-preload')
local partial=created
portraits:sync('map',false,false,'ironclad',true)
local paused=queue()
for _=1,10 do tick()end
assert(created==partial and destroyed==0,'leaving preload did not pause without destroying')
assert(queue()==paused and not selection.visible and not avatar.visible and not selection.active and not avatar.active,
 'leaving preload advanced a paused queue or kept its hosts active')
record('map-paused')
portraits:sync('menu',false,true,'ironclad',true)
for _=1,10 do tick()end
assert(created==partial and destroyed==0 and queue()==paused,'stopped background preload was not cancelled')
record('stopped-partial')
-- A real battle may build its own foreground portrait while both preload queues stay paused.
local background=counts.selection+counts.avatar
foreground=true;portraits:sync('battle',false,false,'ironclad',true);tick()
assert(counts.selection+counts.avatar==background,'foreground battle resumed hidden selection preload')
assert((battleEnabled and counts.battle>0)or(not battleEnabled and counts.battle==0),'battle flag did not own foreground construction')
record('foreground-battle')
portraits:sync('map',false,false,'ironclad',true);foreground=false
local battlePartial=counts.battle;local allPaused=queue();local pausedTotal=created
for _=1,10 do tick()end
assert(created==pausedTotal and counts.battle==battlePartial and destroyed==0 and queue()==allPaused,
 'leaving battle advanced a paused portrait queue')
record('all-paused')
portraits:sync('menu',false,false,'ironclad',true)
for _=1,500 do tick();if portraits:status().avatar.phase=='ready'then break end end
local status=portraits:status()
assert(status.selection.phase=='ready' and status.avatar.phase=='ready')
assert(counts.selection+counts.avatar==expected and counts.battle==battlePartial and destroyed==0 and not panel.visible,
 'unexpected preload count, foreground construction or visible selection')
record('preload-ready')
local readyTotal=created
panel:SetVisible(true)
portraits:sync('menu',true,false,'ironclad',true);tick()
assert(created==readyTotal and destroyed==0,'entering selection rebuilt preloaded art')
portraits:sync('menu',false,true,'ironclad',true);tick()
assert(created==readyTotal and destroyed==0 and not selection.visible and not avatar.visible,'stopped preload kept active hosts')
record('stopped-ready')
foreground=true;portraits:sync('battle',false,false,'ironclad',true)
if battleEnabled then assert(not battleFallback.visible,'building generated portrait restored the yellow placeholder')end
for _=1,500 do tick();if not battleEnabled or portraits:status().battle.phase=='ready'then break end end
assert(counts.selection+counts.avatar==expected,'foreground battle rebuilt cached selection')
assert((battleEnabled and counts.battle==4389 and portraits:status().battle.phase=='ready')or
 (not battleEnabled and counts.battle==0 and portraits:status().battle.phase=='disabled'),'foreground portrait source inventory mismatch')
record('battle-ready')
if battleEnabled then assert(battle.visible and battle.active and not battleFallback.visible,'ready generated portrait visibility mismatch')end
local complete=created
portraits:sync('map',false,false,'ironclad',true);foreground=false;tick()
assert(created==complete and destroyed==0,'leaving completed battle rebuilt or destroyed cached art')
if battleEnabled then assert(not battle.visible and not battle.active and not battleFallback.visible,'paused generated portrait restored placeholder')end
foreground=true;portraits:sync('battle',false,false,'ironclad',true);tick()
assert(created==complete and destroyed==0,'returning to battle rebuilt cached art')
if battleEnabled then assert(battle.visible and battle.active and not battleFallback.visible,'returning generated portrait stayed hidden or restored placeholder')end
portraits:onEngineDestroy();tick()
assert(destroyed==0 and created==complete,'engine teardown called native destruction')
end
profile(true,true,2512)
profile(true,false,2512)
profile(false,true,2440)
Asset.lowpolyHero=lowpolyHero
print('SELECTION_PORTRAIT_PRELOAD_PASS')
